# CANDIDATE: REQUIRE_BEARISH_FILL_BAR_ANCHOR_OOS

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Disabling the REQUIRE_BEARISH_FILL_BAR gate (which currently blocks bearish PUT entries when the fill bar is not bearish) will increase the number of bearish trades. We hypothesize that this may increase edge capture on J anchor days (which are all bearish PUT winners) by allowing more winning entries, but may also increase losses on J loser days. The net effect on edge_capture and Sharpe is unknown without a full OOS real-fills backtest.

## Mechanism

Set the gate parameter `require_bearish_fill_bar` to false (currently true) and run a full OPRA real-fills OOS backtest using the current engine (real fills, ITM-2, −7% cap, chandelier arm+5%/trail15%) over the OOS period (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). Measure the engine P&L on each of the J anchor days (winners: 4/29, 5/01, 5/04; losers: 5/05, 5/06, 5/07 x2) and compute edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_winners) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_losers)). Also compute aggregate Sharpe ratio over the entire OOS period.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (same as leaderboard assumptions)
2. **Sample bias:** We will use the same OOS period as used in the leaderboard for OOS validation (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18). The sample is not random; it is a fixed historical period. Overfit risk is mitigated by using OOS (out-of-sample) and not optimizing on this period.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (we are running the OOS backtest as part of this proposal; result will be filled in after backtest)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (we are using real OPRA fills for the backtest; result will be filled in after backtest)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: unknown until backtest
   - Max drawdown: unknown until backtest
   - Blow-up scenario: if the gate removal causes excessive losses on bearish days due to poor fill bar quality, edge_capture could decrease significantly.
6. **Concentration:** unknown until backtest (we will compute top-5 days concentration as part of the backtest)

## Pre-merge gate

We require:
   - Full OPRA real-fills OOS backtest to complete (using the current engine parameters except for require_bearish_fill_bar=false)
   - The backtest must pass the gym validators (as per Rule 9)
   - The OOS backtest must produce a positive edge_capture on the J anchor days (or at least not decrease it below the rejection floor of 771) to be considered for merging, but we will let the data decide.

2 / 10 -- We have no data yet; the existing candidate REQUIRE_BEARISH_FILL_BAR_REVAL suggests the gate is suppressing a net-winner set (+$917 IS) but we need to see the impact on the anchor days specifically.
